message: No detected untrusted source handling: Files are downloaded via urlretrieve from plain HTTP URLs with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication mechanism.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the dataset during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The --restore argument allows loading checkpoint weights from an arbitrary path, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before loading the weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code references class balancing via inverse median frequency weights (`compute_imf_weights`) but there is no explicit validation of the label distribution or check for expected label sets before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed via sample_gt, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent evaluation sets to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks visible in the inference data-flow path; data is loaded and passed to the model without validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or calibrated thresholds are present in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a hyperspectral image classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
